description: Controlling the price of fuel with the provision of relief by the Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government is taking various measures to properly manage the impact of external shocks caused by the war situation in the Middle East Region on the day to day lives of the general public and the entire economy. Accordingly, taking into account the need for government intervention to control the increase in the prices of octane petrol and auto diesel used for public transport, which are mostly used by the public, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to provide relief to the public by controlling the increase in fuel prices by paying up to Rs.20/- per liter of 92 octane petrol and up to Rs.100/- per liter of auto diesel to the fuel importers, if the imported price exceeds the declared retail price of 92 octane petrol and auto diesel as of 2026-03-22, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Management of Public Expenditure during the Energy Crisis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government has taken various urgent measures to mitigate the impact on the economy due to the prevailing war situation in the Middle East Region. In parallel, the need to manage public expenditure within the fiscal constraints and government approved expenditure ceilings has been identified so as to ensure the continuation of essential public services. Accordingly, taking into account the limitations on the fuel issuance and the declaration of Wednesday as a holiday for government offices providing non-essential services, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to pay the fuel allowance entitled to Ministers, Members of Parliament and Public Officials based on the fuel price as of 2026-03-01 until further notice, and to calculate other allowances as well, based on fuel price prevailing as of 2026-03-01.

description: Amending the Telecommunication Levy Act, No.21 of 2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Telecommunication Levy Act, No.21 of 2011, provides for the imposition of telecommunication levy. Through the budget 2026, it has been proposed to introduce amendments to the said Act incorporating the changes made to the Act from time to time. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has prepared a Bill to amend the Telecommunication Levy Act, No.21 of 2011, incorporating provisions that reflect the existing telecommunications levy rates and all rates applicable since 2014, the applicability of Telecommunication Levy on uncollected revenue (bad debts) and the extension of the application of provisions of the said Act to the providers of telecommunications services. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Transport of the Russian Federation and the Transport, Highways and Urban Development of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-02-12 to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Transport of the Russian Federation and the then Ministry of Transport and Highways of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on the Development of Cooperation in Preparation and Retraining of Personnel in the Transport Sphere. However, the said MoU has not yet been signed. It has been identified that the proposed MoU will enable the acquisition of new knowledge related to concepts and management methods such as multimodal transport, public-private partnership in the transport sector, development of regional and urban transport systems, transport infrastructure management, transport safety, which have already been introduced in the transport sector of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations made under section 156 of the Anti-Corruption Act, No.9 of 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Section 156(1) of the Anti-Corruption Act, No.9 of 2023 states that the Minister may, in consultation with the Commission, make regulations regarding the matters for which provisions are required to be prescribed under the Act. Also, section 82(1) of the Act provides that every person to whom that section applies shall furnish a declaration of assets and liabilities in such form as may be prescribed by regulations. The 'Anti-Corruption (Declaration of Assets and Liabilities through the Centralized Electronic System) Regulations 2026' has been prepared incorporating provisions that enable to furnish declarations of assets and liabilities through a Centralized Electronic System as prescribed by the Anti-Corruption Act. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the said regulations in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prevention of Organized Crimes Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Considering the increasing trend of organized crimes in Sri Lanka, the need to formulate laws to prevent organized crimes and safeguard citizens from such activities has arisen. For the purpose, it has been found that there are shortcomings in the specific laws currently in force and that the existing general laws are also inadequate. Therefore, the Minister of Justice and National Integration has appointed an Expert Committee to prepare a preliminary draft to be taken as a basis for the preparation of a new Bill for the prevention of organized crimes in Sri Lanka. Based on the preliminary draft prepared by the said Committee, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration; and the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill on the Prevention of Organized Crimes in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Chartered Institute of Media Professionals of Sri Lanka Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Policy approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-04-07 to prepare a Bill to establish the Chartered Institute of Media Professionals of Sri Lanka to meet the need for a training institution to conduct relevant studies with the aim of producing chartered media professionals and to raise the quality and standard of the media cohort in this country. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the final Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman for that purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to publish the Chartered Institute of Media Professionals of Sri Lanka Bill in the Government Gazette, and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for laying of HDPE, DI Distribution Mains and Providing Service Connections of the Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project - Phase II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Japan International Cooperation Agency and the Government of Sri Lanka are providing funds for the implementation of the Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project - Phase II, with the aim of providing safe drinking water and increasing water supply coverage by constructing a water supply system covering 164 Grama Niladhari Divisions in the Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Padaviya, Kebitigollewa, Horowpathana, Kahatagasdigiliya, Rambewa and Medawachchiya in the Anuradhapura District, which rely on unsafe groundwater. Although a contractor was selected following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure in 2022 to implement the project, the contract has not been awarded due to the suspension of the release of funds by the Japan International Cooperation Agency. The relevant loan has now been reactivated and the Japan International Cooperation Agency has agreed to award the contract to the selected contractor, subject to price escalation clauses to reflect changes in price levels. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, to award the relevant contract to the Joint Venture of M/s Ceylex Engineering (Pvt) Ltd. and Jayanthi Super Construction (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of Japanese Yen 763.75 million and Rs1.44 billion, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Luxury Apartment Project consisting of 120 housing units in Delkanda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the cabinet meeting held on 2022-01-31 for the implementation of an apartment project of 70 housing units on a land in extent of 100 perches at Delkanda belonging to Ocean View Development (Pvt) Ltd., which is under the purview of the Ministry of Housing, Construction and Water Supply and is established with the share capital of the National Housing Development Authority and the Urban Development Authority. However, due to the adverse economic situation which prevailed in the country at that time, the project was not implemented. The Board of Directors of the Company has decided to increase the proposed housing project from 70 houses to 120 houses and implement the same. Funds required for the purpose are expected to be sourced through the internal funds of the company, pre-sale of housing units and via a bank loan. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to select a suitable contractor for the construction work of the project following the Competitive Bidding Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of 50 MW Battery Energy Storage Systems
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In recent years, it is observed that, although Sri Lanka has experienced a rapid growth in renewable energy capacity, current system observations have identified that peak night-time demand is increasing approximately 2 years earlier than anticipated in the approved Long-Term Generation Expansion Plan. In order to improve the flexibility of the power system and increase the use of renewable energy, the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka has approved the commissioning of the 300 MW Battery Energy Storage System capacity, which was initially planned for the period 2031-2032, during the period 2028-2029 under the Long-Term Power Generation Plan. Accordingly, out of the approved 300 MW Battery Energy Storage System capacity, 250 MW has been decided to be procured through 25 projects of installing 10 MW/40 MWh standalone Battery Energy Storage Systems directly connected to the medium voltage distribution network of the Ceylon Electricity Board. The remaining 50 MW of Battery Energy Storage System capacity is expected to be procured through the connection of Battery Energy Storage Systems with existing ground-mounted solar power plants through a competitive bidding process. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to implement the relevant procurement process for the procurement of the proposed 50 MW Battery Energy Storage System capacity through the Renewable Energy Procurement & Performance Monitoring Division of National System Operator (Pvt) Ltd., a successor company of the Ceylon Electricity Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project for the Establishment of 25 numbers of 10 MW/40 MWh Standalone Battery Energy Storage Systems
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In recent times, the capacity of renewable energy, especially solar power installations, has shown a rapid growth, and this trend is expected to continue. It has been observed that the solar power capacity generated under that backdrop has also surpassed the solar energy integration requirements within the framework of the Long-Term Generation Plan 2023-2042. Therefore, in order to increase the utilization of renewable energy, it has been planned to establish 25 numbers of 10 MW/40 MWh Standalone Battery Energy Storage Systems to be able to store energy for later use. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to implement the project for the installation of the said 25 battery energy storage systems on Build, Own and Operate basis with an operational period of 15 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of alternative rice varieties as a remedy to the existing shortage of samba and keeri samba in the domestic market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Consumer Affairs Authority has indicated that the total production of Samba and Keeri Samba in the 2025/26 Maha season is not sufficient to meet the demand of the those rice varieties in the country and that there could be an acute shortage of those rice from May 2026 onwards, based on the updated information submitted by the Department of Agriculture, Hector Kobbekaduwa Agricultural Research and Training Institute and the National Postharvest Management Institute. The need to import rice equivalent to the rice varieties of Samba and Keeri Samba in order to meet the market demand for those rice varieties at a stable price has also drawn the attention of the Food Policy and Security Committee. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the joint proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation; and the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to allow any importer to import a maximum quantity of 1,040 metric tons of rice variety known as GR 11, including Ponni Samba and Keeri/Pal Ponni rice, which are considered as substitutes for Samba and Keeri Samba respectively and classified under Harmonized Classification Code (HS Code) 1006.30.29, during the period from 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30, to clear the said rice stocks from the Sri Lanka Customs on or before 2026-05-31, and to exempt importers importing the said rice varieties from obtaining import control licenses.

description: Procurement for the improvement of Colombo-Galle-Hambanthota-Wellawaya (A 002) Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - National competitive bids have been invited for the procurement for the improvement of 04 road sections covering a distance of 9.91 km of the Colombo-Galle-Hambantota - Wellawaya Road (A 002) in the Kalutara District. Eight (08) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, following the evaluation of the said bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the said contract to M/s NEM Construction (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of Rs.1, 228.25 million (excluding taxes), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Carrying out a feasibility study on the construction of Three Dry Dams in the Kalu Ganga Basin for Flood Mitigation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Kalu Ganga Basin, which has a catchment area of 2,839 square kilometers, is considered to be the most flood-prone river basin in the country due to its frequent flooding and flood-related damages. Therefore, a pre-feasibility study has been conducted to identify strategies to protect the residents and infrastructure of the Kalu Ganga Basin from flood damage. Following the said feasibility study, the recommendation for the construction of three dry dams at Malwala, Dela II and Dela III has been identified as appropriate to be accorded priority, from among the recommendations made for potential flood protection measures in the basin. Accordingly, it has been planned to carry out a feasibility study for the construction of the three dry dams. The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to award the consultancy services contract of the said feasibility study to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Compensation to those who lost their farming lands in executing the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2012-06-27, granted approval to allocate agricultural lands from the Uma Oya downstream to 276 farming families in Hali Ela, Welimada and Uva Paranagama Divisional Secretariat Divisions, who lost their farming lands due to land acquisition for the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project. However, the said proposal could not be implemented due to the encroachment of a large portion of the identified lands by unauthorized persons, dense forest cover, threat of wild elephants, long distance from the original residential areas and difficulties in adapting to other environmental and social anomalies. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Lands and Irrigation to pay an assessed compensation of Rs.12 lakhs per family to the said 276 farming families, based on the recommendation submitted by the Cabinet Sub-Committee appointed to make recommendations to resolve the issues that have arisen in implementing the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Consultancy Service Contract to prepare the Watershed Management Plan for the Kelani River Basin
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-06-16 to procure consultancy services to prepare a comprehensive Watershed Management Plan for the Kelani River Basin enabling to reduce the pollution in the catchment area in the Kelani River Basin and improve the overall river water quality. Expressions of Interest have been invited for the procurement of the said consultancy service. Requests for Proposals have been issued for 4 shortlisted institutions out of 07 Expressions of Interest submitted for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to award the said Consultancy Services Contract to Resources Development Consultants (Private) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.206.65 million (including taxes), based on the recommendation submitted by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee after evaluating the proposals received, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Digital Communication and Collaboration Platform
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-10-21, granted approval for the implementation of the Digital Economy Plan of Sri Lanka. Under this, the need to establish a Digital Communication and Collaboration Platform, which includes the necessary artificial intelligence tools to facilitate public officials, as a fundamental step in modernizing the public sector in line with the National Policy Framework and the vision for a strong digital economy, has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy, to implement the 'National Digital Communication and Collaboration Platform' project in the year 2026 with an estimated total investment of Rs. 626 million, with the aim of establishing a secure and modern digital platform for communication and collaboration for all Government employees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the proposed Maha Oya Pumped Storage Hydropower Plant Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ceylon Electricity Board had planned to implement the Maha Oya Pumped Storage Hydropower Plant as a grid-scale energy storage solution to utilize the surplus energy generated from renewable sources. The implementation of the proposed project is expected to store energy during periods of low demand and to supply the stored energy to the electricity system during periods of high demand. The project, with a total cost estimate of Sri Lankan Rupees 243.09 billion, is planned to be implemented in two phases as the development phase and the construction phase. Accordingly, the Cabinet granted approval for the implementation of the proposed project by securing necessary funds in accordance with the provisions of the Public Debt Management Act No.33 of 2024.

description: State Vesak Festival – 2026 (2570 B.E
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the advice of the Most Venerable Mahanayake Theros and the Samastha Lanka Shasanarakshaka Mandalaya, the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs together with the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government and the Department of Buddhist Affairs have identified that it would be appropriate to hold the State Vesak Festival in the year 2026 (2570 B.E.) at the Thihagoda, Midellawala Purana Viharaya, Matara District, centralizing the Matara District. It has been decided to hold the State Vesak Festival this year under the theme 'Abhiththaretha Kalyane' (Let's get aligned immediately for the common good). Accordingly, the joint proposal submitted by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government and the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to hold the State Vesak Festival centralizing the Midellawala Purana Viharaya, Thihagoda in the Matara District, to declare the period from 27th May to 02nd June, 2026 as the Vesak Week, and to organize and implement various Buddhist programmes throughout the country during the said period, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of Tourist Visas free of charge for passport holders of 39 countries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-07-21 to implement a programme to issue tourist visas free of charge for a period of 6 months to passport holders of 39 selected countries with the aim of promoting the tourism industry in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to submit the draft Regulations prepared by the Legal Draftsman in accordance with the provisions of the Immigrants and Emigrants Act for the issuance of tourist visas free of charge, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Inclusion of children under institutional care and guardianship and vulnerable children in the 'Arth' Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-06-16, granted approval for the implementation of a programme called 'Artha' with the objective of providing a monthly cost of living allowance of Rs.5,000/- to children under institutional care or guardianship and street children. The proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to implement the 'Artha' programme by further expanding said programme, having the children belonging to the following groups also included as beneficiaries of the said programme, in addition to the children currently in Child Development Centres:Children who have lost both parents, as well as those who lost either their mother or father, due to the cyclone "Ditwah" and the subsequent destructive floods and landslides;Children identified by the Department of Probation and Child Care Services as being vulnerable and at risk due to economic and social deprivation, broken families, and other social factors, and who lack a safe environment suitable for living.

description: Implementation of the 'Diviyata Saviyak' Housing Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to a Budget proposal 2025, the Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-08-18, granted approval for the implementation of the 'Programme to Provide Financial Assistance to Secure Housing Facilities to low-income couples reintegrated subsequent to institutional care'. Further strengthening the aforesaid programme, Rs.2,000 million has been allocated through the Budget proposals 2026 to provide a financial assistance of Rs.2 million per beneficiary, to individuals who, at any stage of their lives, have resided in child development centres and have been reintegrated into the society and to the families of vulnerable children, for the purpose of purchasing a land and constructing a house, constructing a house on a land owned by them, purchasing a house or renovating an existing house. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to provide the said financial assistance to the following beneficiary groups, based on the criteria formulated and the relevant procedure for providing financial assistance, was approved by the Cabinet:Individuals below 45 years of age who have left institutional care upon reaching the age of 18 years or earlier and do not have a stable and safe home for living.Families with children who are in vulnerable and at-risk situations as they do not have a safe home to live in due to the lack of a proper family background or a stable livelihood or because their current residence is not sufficiently safe for living.Children aged between 16 and 18 years who are in institutional care, as well as young men and women over the age of 18 years who continue to remain in Child Development Centers due to their inability to reintegrate into the society.

description: Preventing export of scrap metal products, harmonizing the domestic industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Part of the metal requirement for the domestic manufacturing industries in the country is met by locally sourced scrap metal and the rest by imported metal ingots. In order to protect local small-scale industrialists, the export of scrap metal of steel, copper, aluminum, stainless steel, high carbon steel, brass and cast iron as well as aluminum ingots, zinc ingots and copper wire has been suspended as per a decision taken at the Cabinet meeting held on 2020-11-09. However, due to the export of counterfeit metal-related products and scrap metal by certain parties under different HS Codes on different interpretations, a shortage of locally sourced metal-related raw materials is caused for domestic industries. In consideration of the above situation, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to impose the necessary legal provisions to prevent any detrimental effect caused by the export of scrap metal to the domestic industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Sri Lanka Climate and Nature-Positive Investment Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Climate Finance Strategy of Sri Lanka for the period 2025-2030 was launched on 2025-10-24 with the approval of the Cabinet. The need to establish a new integrated framework with a legally-empowered authority to oversee the activities taking place in the Central Highlands, bringing together all relevant parties, has been identified to recover from the catastrophic impact of Cyclone Ditwah. Further, it has also been planned to establish a fund called Climate and Nature Positive Investment Fund - CANOPI Fund to raise funds from domestic and foreign sources for investments that include climate impact mitigation, adaptation and conservation activities. The proposed Fund should be a Statutory Fund established by an Act of Parliament in accordance with the provisions of the Public Finance Management Act No.44 of 2024. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to take further steps pertaining to preparing a Bill to establish the proposed Authority for the restoration of Central Highlands and the Nature-Positive Investment Fund, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of new Circular Instructions for admission of students from Grade 2 to Grade 11 in Schools except Grades 5 and 6
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-09-03 to issue new Circular instructions pertaining to admission of students from Grade 2 to Grade 11 in Schools except Grades 5 and 6 by regularizing the methodology which prevailed in admitting students to schools while maintaining the number of students in a class room within the approved limit as per the new education reforms initiated in the year 2026. Accordingly, the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education has issued the Circular No.27/2025 dated 2025-09-09. Since certain practical issues have arisen in implementing the said Circular, the necessity of issuing new Circular instructions without affecting the amendments introduced by the previous Circular so as to address the said issues, has been identified. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence to issue new Circular instructions with regard to the admission of students from Grade 2 to Grade 11 except Grades 5 and 6 to be effective from the year 2026 onwards, taking into consideration of the proposal made by the Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education.

description: Obtaining the assistance of the Government of Japan for the establishment of an Amateur Radio Emergency Communication Network for Disaster Response
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In view of the difficulties encountered by emergency services and humanitarian agencies in making quick responses to disasters and coordinating relief operations due to the disruption of conventional communication networks in disaster situations which occurred recently, the need for an alternative communication network has been identified. Accordingly, the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka, in collaboration with the Radio Society of Sri Lanka, has taken the initiative to implement a programme to use Amateur Radio Communication Systems to support communication during emergencies where conventional communication networks are not operational. The Government of Japan has agreed to provide a Grant of US$ 181,837 through the Embassy of Japan in Sri Lanka under the programme of ‘Grant Assistance for Grassroots Human Security Projects' for the purchase of the required amateur radio communication equipment for the said programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy, to sign a Grant Agreement with the Government of Japan to accept the said Grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accelerating the National QR Payments Adoption
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government has identified the promotion of the digital economy as a national priority to enhance economic efficiency, financial inclusion and financial transparency. Cash is heavily used for everyday retail transactions in the country, whereby transparency and the growth of the digital economy have been limited. Although the LankaQR infrastructure is currently operational with over 20 financial institutions and nearly 30 mobile applications, their active use is relatively low. During the third quarter of 2025, approximately 274,000 transactions were recorded through LankaQR, with a total value of about Rs.1.18 billion. This works out to an average of about 90,000 transactions per month, with a value of about Rs. 390 million. Accordingly, it is observed that the value of an average transaction made through QR code is less than Rs.5,000/. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy, to implement a programme for promoting digital payments based on QR codes without charging any additional fees to both the sender and the recipient for transactions below Rs.5,000/- taking into consideration the above matters and in line with the proposal presented in the 2026 Budget in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of Bus Fares
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - When the increase in the price of Lanka Auto Diesel on 2026-03-22 is matched up with the bus fare index, the current bus fare should be increased by 12.19%. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development based on the recommendation submitted by the National Transport Commission to increase the bus fare of normal services, semi-luxury services, luxury services and super-luxury services (on both expressways and normal roads) by 12.19% and implement the same with effect from midnight on 2026-03-23, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Government Printer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The period of service of Mr. S.D. Pandikorala, presently serving in the Post of Government Printer, is due to expire on 2026-04-01. At present, there is no Special Grade Officer of the Printing Service of the Department of Government Printing who has completed the requisite qualifications in the Department of Government Printing, according to the Government Printing Service Minute dated 06-26-2013. Therefore, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media, the Cabinet decided to appoint Mr. R. A. P. K. Jayaratne, Class I, Grade II Officer of the Sri Lanka Printing Service and the most senior officer of the said Service, who is currently serving as the Deputy Government Printer of the Department of Government Printing, to attend to the duties in the Post of Government Printer, on a full-time basis, with effect from 2026-04-02.

description: Awarding the Contract for Improvement and Rehabilitation of the Kurikadduvan Jetty of the Jaffna District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-10-21 to improve and Rehabilitate the Kurikadduvan Jetty of the Jaffna District. Bids have been invited for the said procurement by following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure and 5 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the said contract to M/s RR Construction (Pvt) Ltd at a sum of Rs.984.73 million (excluding tax), based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for the improvement of Passenger Facilities at the Colombo Fort Railway Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-06-02, granted approval for the project for improving passenger facilities at the Colombo Fort Railway Station, which includes the construction of new bridges with access for persons with special needs by removing the passenger bridges at the Maradana and Bambalapitiya ends of the Colombo Fort Railway Station, and the construction of new ticket counters along the passenger bridges and the construction of a three-storey service building. Accordingly, bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure to select a suitable entity to award the relevant contract. 04 entities have submitted bids. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the said contract to           M/s. MAGA Engineering (Pvt) Ltd for a sum of Rs.2,162.64 million (excluding tax), the substantially responsive lowest bidder, based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Programme for Providing Sanitary Napkins for Female School Students
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement the programme for providing sanitary napkins for female students who attained puberty, covering pubescent female students studying in Grade 6 and above in all Government Schools and about 1.05 million pubescent female students in the Assisted Special Schools in this year as well, with a view to ensuring the continuous education of female students. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity of Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to implement the programme for providing sanitary napkins for female students in the year 2026 to provide two gift vouchers with a value of Rs.720/- each totaling to Rs.1,440/- and provide them with opportunity to purchase 12 packets with 08 napkins at the rate of Rs.120/- each or 8 packets with 10 napkins at Rs.180/- each, at their option, during the year, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project for the Development of Playgrounds in Government Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The examination oriented education system driven by the competitive education system and non-availability of adequate infrastructure facilities for sports activities have resulted in causing an unsatisfactory level of participation in sports activities of school students and it is observed that it creates in the promotion of their physical, social and mental well-being. It also affects the identification of outstanding athletes who have the potential to perform at the national and international levels. Since it has been confirmed that, of the 10,096 government schools Island wide, standard sized playgrounds are available only in a limited number of schools which is around 5%, the need to establish at least one standard playground with a 400-meter running track in each education zone, has been identified to ensure equitable access for students in sports. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to implement the project to develop playgrounds in 400 schools within 4 years, covering all 25 districts, with one national school and 3 provincial schools in each district, at an estimated cost of Rs.2010.50 million, during the period of 2026-2029, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking over of the Base Hospital, Mahiyanganaya under the Ministry of Health and Mass Media for development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Mahiyanganaya Hospital, a base hospital of type 'A', is the third largest hospital in the Badulla District of the Uva Province. The said hospital, which is currently governed under the Uva Provincial Council, provides healthcare services to a population of about 500,000 in 06 surrounding districts. Buildings of the said hospital were severely damaged by the cyclone ‘Ditwah’ and significant disruptions have arisen in the provision of clinical services due to damage caused to medical and non-medical equipment. Also, in managing the hospital and meeting the increasing demand for healthcare services, further development of infrastructure facilities has become a challenge to the Uva Provincial Council. In view of the said issues, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to take over the Mahiyanganaya Base Hospital under the Line Ministry of Health and Mass Media, with the concurrence of the Hon. Governor of Uva Province, in order to upgrade the facilities of the said hospital to the provide tertiary care, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Civil Aviation Master Plan of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The International Civil Aviation Organization, established in 1944, provides guidance in creating a global network by assisting States in formulating national regulations pertaining to the safety, security, efficiency, capacity and environmental protection in their air services. The said organization has emphasized that the availability of a comprehensive and well-thought-out approach is essential for a State to effectively function the aviation sector and pointed out that a Civil Aviation Master Plan need to be compiled as a crucial tool for the same. Further, the said organization has also emphasized the need for the strategic development planning for the aviation system in the context of post –covid pandemic recovery of aviation activities. Accordingly, the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka has prepared the National Civil Aviation Master Plan with the participation of all relevant parties, as recommended by the International Civil Aviation Organization. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to implement the said plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Loan Scheme to Develop Young Entrepreneurs in the Agricultural and Industrial Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to the Government’s policy statement, the Government should take steps to provide financial support and guidance to create 50,000 entrepreneurs within five years. Accordingly, as one step towards achieving that goal Rs.500 million was allocated to implement a concessional loan scheme, through a budget proposal of 2025. Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2025-08-18 to utilize the said amount for the implementation of the Loan Scheme to Develop Young Entrepreneurs in the Agricultural and Industrial Sector. Provisions of Rs.750 million have been allocated in the budget for the year 2026 to further implement the said loan scheme. Accordingly, the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation submitted the measures planned by his Ministry to implement the said loan scheme through the People's Bank, the Bank of Ceylon and the Regional Development Bank at an annual interest rate of 4% and to issue relevant guidelines, to the attention of the Cabinet and the Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the same.

description: Appointment of a National Steering Committee for Education Reforms
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The new educational reform process initiated in the year 2019 was implemented for Grade 1 in 2026 in line with the policies of the present government, and the reforms for Grade 6 are planned to be implemented from the year 2027. The need to appoint a Steering Committee comprising of experts in the field has been identified to enable the continuous implementation and to regulate the educational reforms process. Accordingly, taking into account a proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, approval of the Cabinet was granted to establish the National Steering Committee for Education Reforms consisting of relevant Ministers, experts in the field, officials, professionals and representatives of trade unions.

description: Recommencement of the project for the Establishment of ICT Hubs for Secondary Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2018-06-05 to implement the ‘Establishment of ICT Hubs for Secondary Education Project’ with the aim of streamlining IT education and the use of IT for education in schools in Sri Lanka, under a loan provided by the Economic Development Cooperation Fund under the Korean EXIM Bank and funds of the Government of Sri Lanka. Under the said project, it has been planned to establish a national level e-learning center and two provincial IT centers for the Southern Province and the Eastern Province. Also, the implementation of this project is expected to create an e-learning programme to introduce a formal e-learning method covering all 03 sectors of education viz. general education, higher education and vocational education. Although relevant agreements were entered into in November 2019 for the implementation of the project, it has not been possible to implement the project as planned. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to recommence and implement the project, based on the recommendations submitted by an Expert Committee upon a re review regarding the implementation of the entire project.

description: Appointment of an Expert Committee on the Development of Energy Economy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government has recognized the importance of exploring and implementing novel and futuristic perspectives to achieve and retain a sustainable growth in the national economy. Accordingly, the Energy Economy has been identified as a priority sector, but due to the weakness in integration among key economic sectors, there seems a low interest in investment participation in the said sector.  Taking the aforesaid factors into account, the need for an integrated economic development framework to build a sustainable economy was emphasized by the Hon. President through the Budget for the year 2026. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to appoint an Expert Committee under the Chairmanship of Dr. Hans Wijesuriya to prepare the Framework for Development of the Energy Economy harmonizing the National Policies, Strategies and Results Delivery Frameworks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaring Wednesday as a public holiday as a solution to the existing fuel crisis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The attention of the Cabinet was drawn on the appropriateness of restricting the number of days the Government Offices are kept open, as a temporary solution to the issue of securing fuel which has arisen due to the war situation prevailing in the Middle East Region. After discussion, the Cabinet decided to declare every Wednesday of the week as a Holiday for Government Offices, enabling to economize the usage of the existing stocks of fuel and to face the uncertain situation in the procurement of stocks of fuel in the future and to authorize the Secretary, Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to issue detailed Circular instructions related thereto.

description: Procurement of Petroleum, Petroleum related Products, Liquefied Petroleum Gas and Coal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The global energy market has been severely disrupted by the escalating geopolitical tensions and armed conflicts in the Middle East region. As Sri Lanka is completely dependent on imported petroleum and petroleum related products, liquefied petroleum gas and coal, this situation has a direct and immediate impact on the country’s energy supply and energy security. As a direct result of the ongoing conflicts, there have been cancellations of shipments, refusal of insurance providers to provide insurance coverage, and reluctance of suppliers to enter into long-term contracts, it has become essential to adopt a temporary and flexible procurement framework to ensure continuous energy supply. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to procure petroleum, petroleum related products, liquefied petroleum gas, and coal for a period of three months, in consultation with the National Procurement Commission, outside standard procurement guidelines, while taking into account possible future circumstances.

description: Emergency Procurement of Coal for the Lakvijaya Power Plant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-01-26 to purchase 300,000 ± 10% MT(05 shipments) of coal to the Lakvijaya Power Plant in Norochcholai as an emergency procurement. Accordingly, bids have been invited from the coal suppliers registered under Lanka Coal Company (Pvt) Ltd. Six (06) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation made after evaluating the said bids by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the relevant procurement to M/s. Taranjot Resources (Pvt) Ltd of India, the substantially lowest responsive bidder, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Oversight Committees for the restoration of Economic Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Due to the volatile global environment created by the ongoing war in the Middle East, Sri Lanka, as a country with a small economy, has been exposed to various impacts. Therefore, it is essential to make timely interventions to take prompt and progressive measures to address the unforeseen risks affecting Sri Lanka, stabilize market conditions and ensure the daily lives of citizens. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President to establish 04 Committees as follows, to make appropriate recommendations jointly with the Committee on Economic Surveillance, on immediate measures to be taken to minimize the adverse impacts of global instability on the domestic economy and people’s lives:



Committee
Duties




Committee on Energy - Chaired by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment, and Tourism
To carry out necessary procurement activities for emergency purchases to maintain a stable supply of fuel, gas, and coal and to identify supply sources and new suppliers.


Committee for the Systematic Functioning of the Public Service - Chaired by the Prime Minister
To make prompt decisions to ensure the continuous, efficient and systematic functioning of the public service, sustain economic activities and provide essential services to the public.


Committee for Monitoring the Distribution of Essential Goods -Chaired by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development
To ensure the uninterrupted functioning of public and private supply chains for essential goods and to guarantee that goods are available to the public at reasonable prices without market shortages.


Committee for the Provision of Welfare to Various Segments of Society -Chaired by the Minister of Rural Development, Social Security, and Community Empowerment
To promptly identify issues and impacts affecting daily life and to coordinate with relevant sectors to provide prompt responses.

description: Declaration of ‘National Namal Uyana’ as a National Heritage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The ‘National Namal Uyana’, which is considered as the largest ‘Na’ (Ceylon Iron Wood) forest in Sri Lanka and has been declared a forest reserve, covers an area of about 602 hectares and has been identified as one of the highly significant sites with historical and archaeological value in Sri Lanka. The pink quartz mountain range located in the Namal Uyana is a very important geo-natural heritage in Sri Lanka. The pink quartz mountain range with its unique mineral and features with scientific value, a distinctive dry zone forest ecosystem and the landscapes of ancient Buddhist monasteries combined with long-lasting cultural relationships generate a rare combination of geological, environmental and cultural heritage values, and the Cabinet Sub-Committee on the identification of National Heritages of Sri Lanka has recommended that it would be appropriate to declare the ‘National Namal Uyana’ as a national heritage site. Based on the said recommendation, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs and the Minister of Environment to declare the ‘National Namal Uyana’as a national heritage, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Policy Based Lending from the Asian Development Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Asian Development Bank has granted its concurrence to provide policy-based lending to advance Sri Lanka’s reform agenda in line with the International Monetary Fund’s Extended Fund Facility Programme. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to obtain US$ 620 million from the Asian Development Bank under the following 05 sub-programmes:

Trade, Investment and Industry Development Programme - USD 100 million


Building a Strong and Inclusive Financial Ecosystem for Micro, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises -MSMEs Programme - USD 220 million


Water Supply and Sanitation Reform Programme - USD 100 million


Promoting Resilience and Opportunity for Inclusive Recovery Sector Development Programme - USD 100 million


Agriculture Value Chain Financing and Commercialization Sector Development Project - USD 100 million

description: Amending the Central Cultural Fund Act, No.57 of 1980
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The tasks such as, the development of cultural and religious monuments in Sri Lanka, meeting the expenses incurred for the development, reconstruction and protection of local and foreign cultural monuments, developing cultural affairs, and providing financial assistance to artistes as well as making donations to those who have served for the nation in the cultural and religious spheres are undertaken by the Central Cultural Fund, established under the provisions of the Central Cultural Fund Act No. 57 of 1980. More than 45 years have elapsed since the passing of the said Act in Parliament, and the need to amend the provisions contained therein to suit the present needs has been identified. Accordingly, taking into account the proposal submitted by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs, policy approval of the Cabinet was granted to amend the said Act.

description: Making Regulations under the Provisions of the Antiquities Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 'Antiquities Gift Fund' can be used for the purpose of rewarding informants and implementing officers who contribute to the recovery of illegally exploited antiquities or to the protection of sites and antiquities. Accordingly, in order to  further motivate and encourage the staff members of the stakeholder institutions including the Department of Archaeology, the importance of paying a percentage of the allowance using the Antiquities Gift Fund has been recognized. For this purpose, the Antiquities Gift Fund Regulations have been drafted under the Provisions of section 46 and Section 47 of the Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188). The proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to submit the said draft Regulations to Parliament for approval and thereafter publish the same through a Gazette Notification, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance (Chapter 218)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-01-12 to appoint an Officials’ Committee under the chairmanship of the Secretary, Ministry of Justice and National Integration to submit appropriate recommendations for introducing laws for the disposal of drugs in custody before the conclusion of the trial, after retaining only a sample for evidence, including the procedure for the disposal of drugs seized in future. The Legal Draftsman has prepared a Preliminary draft, incorporating the amendments identified for section 77(A) of the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance (Chapter 218) to facilitate the expeditious destruction of such drugs while ensuring the protection of the rights of all parties. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the final draft to amend the said Ordinance in all the three languages, ​​was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations made under the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act (Chapter 203)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Regulations applicable to the fees for reserving special numbers up to next 50,000 numbers from numbers issued for all motor vehicles by the Department of Motor Traffic have been published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2023-10-05. Regulations have been published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2470/14 dated 2026-01-05 by amending the said Regulations to make legal provisions enabling to reserve special numbers from 50,000 up to 100,000 from the numbers issued for all motor vehicles other than motorcycles, motor tricycles and motor tricycle vans and to charge a fee of Rs.1,000,000/- for each such number. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Transfer of Passenger Service Permits Regulations published under the National Transport Commission Act, No.37 of 1991
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into account the problems faced by bus owners as well as the National Transport Commission due to the fact that a passenger service permit granted to a person in terms of the provisions of the National Transport Commission Act No.37 of 1991 cannot be transferred to another person and such transfer is null and void, actions have been taken to amend the said provisions through the National Transport Commission (Amendment) Act, No.8 of 2025. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to submit the Transfer of Passenger Service Permits Regulations No.1 of 2026, published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2471/68 dated 2026-01-07, made in accordance with the provisions of the National Transport Commission Act, incorporating the legal criteria to be applicable for the transfer of a Passenger Service Permit, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Colombo Port City (Guidelines on the Grant of Exemptions or Incentives to Business of Strategic Importance-Duty Free Operations) Regulations, No. 01 of 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-12-22, granted approval to amend the relevant Regulations to allow a passenger arriving from abroad to purchase goods from the duty-free shopping complex at the Colombo Port City on two occasions within 4 days from the date of arrival in the country, without revising the limit of the approved annual duty entitlement of US$ 2,000. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to present the amended Regulations, which have been published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2475/28 dated 2026-02-13, to Parliament in accordance with the provisions of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act No. 11 of 2021, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Double Circuit Transmission Line from the Mannar Grid Substation to Mullikulam Collector Grid Substation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-02-03, has granted approval to implement the formal procurement procedure to select a contractor for the construction of a 28 km long 220 kV double circuit transmission line from Mannar Grid Substation to Mullikulam Collector Grid Substation under Lot B of the Mullikulam Wind Power Transmission Project. Bids have been invited for this as per the International Competitive Bidding Procedure, and 05 bids have been submitted. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the said contract to, JSL & Fentons Joint Venture - Intend (Jyoti Structure Limited, India and Hayleys Fentons Limited, Sri Lanka), the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum equivalent to Sri Lankan Rupees 2,269.18 million (excluding taxes), based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of Contract for supplying Ground Handling Services for the Aircraft of Sri Lankan Airlines at the Male Airport (MLE) in Maldives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The current contract for the provision of Ground Handling Services for Aircraft of SriLankan Airlines at the Male Airport is scheduled to expire on 2026-03-31. Accordingly, a proposal has been received from the sole service provider that supplies ground handling services at the said Airport for the provision of the said services. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the contract for the provision of Ground Handling Services to Maldives Airports Company Limited for a period of 03 years with effect from 2026-04-01 at a cost of US$ 16.19 million, based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said proposal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Physical Infrastructure available in the Provincial Education Departments, Zonal Education Offices and Divisional Education Offices and the Provision of Equipment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that, since the physical and infrastructure facilities available in some Provincial Education Departments, Zonal Education Offices and Divisional Education Offices are old and limited, both teachers and students are hindered from carrying out their educational activities efficiently. In line with the new education policy of the Government, a project has been planned to be implemented to develop the physical and infrastructure facilities and provide equipment to the Provincial Education Departments, Zonal Education Offices and Divisional Education Offices with the aim of enhancing the service efficiency and productivity and employee job satisfaction by strengthening the physical and infrastructure facilities and office structures of the education system, thereby ensuring the provision of quality education to the student community and minimizing the disparity in the distribution of resources within the education system. The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to implement the proposed project in coordination with the relevant Provincial Councils over a period of 03 years from 2026 to 2028 at an estimated cost of Rs. 1,264 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Project for the Establishment of a Big Data Platform for Water Environment Monitoring and Data Driven Policy Implementation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Central Environmental Authority regulates the discharge of industrial wastewater by issuing Environmental Protection Licenses. Accordingly, a large amount of data which has been collected through the Kelani River Water Quality Monitoring Programme, can be evaluated and used for decision-making. However, due to the lack of adequate trained officers for the same and inadequate facilities for data analysis and forecasting, it has been a challenging task to monitor the actual discharge status of wastewater and identify the exact sources of pollutants. Considering this situation, a project proposal titled ‘Establishment of Big Data Platform for Water Environment Monitoring and Data Driven Policy Implementation ' has been submitted to the Japan International Cooperation Agency under the Science and Technology Research Partnership for Sustainable Development Programme as a Joint Research Project by the Central Environmental Authority, the University of Moratuwa and the Tohoku University, Japan. The Japan International Cooperation Agency has agreed to provide a Grant of Rs. 646 million for the implementation of the said project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to obtain the said Grant and implement the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking legal action against persons transferring money relating to the drug trafficking and organized crimes by using eZCash and mCash Money Transfer Methods
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that eZCash and mCash money transfer methods are widely used for anonymous financial transactions related to drug trafficking and organized crime. Approval of the Cabinet has previously been granted for the appointment of a Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Ministry of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to submit a Report to the Cabinet with recommendations on the steps to be taken to bring those involved in such transactions to justice. Accordingly, taking into account the recommendations submitted by the said Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to take necessary steps to prevent the relevant illegal activities and to identify and take legal action against those involved in such activities through a database to be developed by integrating the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, the Sri Lanka Police and the Department of Registration of Persons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Electric Motorcycles to Field Officers engaged in duties in the Fishery Sector under a Grant of India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Special attention of the Government has been paid for providing the necessary facilities to the Field Officers of the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources and the National Aquaculture Development Authority falling under the Ministry of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources and the Field Research Assistants of the National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency to perform their duties with effectiveness, efficiency and job satisfaction. Accordingly, it has been planned to provide electric motorcycles to 430 officers engaged in field-level duties in the Fisheries Sector in the year 2026 with the aim of providing them with the necessary transport facilities without any hindrance. The Government of India has agreed to provide the relevant cost for the purchase of the said motorcycles, amounting to Sri Lankan Rupees 264.59 million, as a Financial Grant. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of India to obtain the said Grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Committee on Economic Surveillance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A volatile global environment that could adversely impact the economy emerged, owing to the prevailing war situation in the Middle East region. Sri Lanka being a small economy is exposed to external economic shocks due to its dependence on energy imports from the Middle East, remittances from expatriate workers working in the Middle East region, and trade and investment relations with that region. Under that backdrop, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President to appoint the Committee on Economic Surveillance, under the chairmanship of  Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando, the Minister of Labor in his capacity as the Deputy Minister of Finance and Planning, and comprising of the heads of relevant institutions and experts in the field, to constantly monitor the possible impact on the Sri Lankan economy, assess the risks across multiple sectors and submit recommendations to the Cabinet on the necessary policy measures to be taken accordingly, constantly reviewing the current situation.

description: Procurement for the Supply and Installation of Oracle Exadata System and related Software Licenses for the Sri Lanka Customs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-08-21 to implement the procurement for the selection of an appropriate institution for the supply of Oracle Exadata System and related Software Licenses for the Sri Lanka Customs. Accordingly, bids have been invited following the national competitive bidding procedure, and three (03) bids have been received for the same. After evaluating the financial bid of the only technically qualified bidder among the said bids, based on the recommendations submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the said procurement, to Millennium I.T.E.S.P. (Private) Limited for a period of 08 years for a sum of Rs.2,197.96 million (Excluding Taxes), was approved by the Cabinet of Ministers.

description: Provision of relief for the replantation of disaster affected export agricultural crops- Tea, Coconut and Rubber
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has already been granted to provide relief for the farmers for the prompt replanting of field crops, vegetables and fruit crops damaged due to the adverse weather condition which prevailed in late November 2025, and the provision of relief for the replanting of minor export crops such as pepper, coffee and cardamom that were damaged due to the said disaster, and measures have been taken as of now to provide relevant concessions to the beneficiary farmers. Similarly, the Ministry of Plantation and Community Infrastructure has submitted recommendations to the General Treasury regarding the necessity of providing relief for the replanting of damaged plantations of tea, coconut and rubber. Based on those recommendations, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to provide relief as follows in view of the impact of the disaster, was approved by the Cabinet:

A maximum of Rs.500,000/- per hectare for Tea Cultivation.
A maximum of Rs.400,000/- per hectare for Rubber Cultivation.
A maximum of Rs.750,000/- per hectare for Coconut Cultivation.

description: Extending the validity period of visa free of charge for the foreigners affected by the cancellation of Middle- East bound flights
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to the existing war situation in the Middle East region, and subsequent cancellation of flights to that region from 2026-02-28, some foreigners who were scheduled to leave the country have not been able to leave the country before the expiry of their visas. Considering that exceptional circumstance, such passengers need to be facilitated to remain legally in Sri Lanka until they are able to make alternative travel arrangements. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to grant visa extensions free of charge for a period of 14 days to foreigners who have not been able to leave the country due to the cancellation of flights to the Middle East from 2026-02-28 and to grant them visa extensions free of charge for a further 14 days, in the event of further such flight cancellations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising the amount paid for constructing a house under the resettlement programme for families affected by landslides and high-risk landslide zones
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The resettlement programme of identifying the families that have to be evacuated from their residences due to being located in landslide areas and the areas of high risk of landslides is to be implemented under the ‘beneficiary-build-the-house method’. Under the said programme, a maximum of Rs.1.6 million is provided to an identified beneficiary family for the construction of one house, and the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defense to increase that amount to Rs.2.5 million per house, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Ampara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration a proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, the Cabinet decided to appoint Mr. Anupama Mangala Wickramarachchi, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as the Additional Commissioner General of Agrarian Development in the Department of Agrarian Development, to the post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Ampara, with immediate effect.

description: Appointment to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Badulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration a proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, the Cabinet decided to appoint Mr. Sunil Galagama, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as an Additional Secretary of the Ministry of Health and Mass Media, to the post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Badulla, with immediate effect.

description: Construction of the Elapatha Divisional Secretariat Building and the development of Infrastructure Facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
